items.title: The Blade Runner Collection by Titan Comics
items.description: Discover the next chapter of Blade Runner’s story
items.long_description: Are you on the side of humanity or technology? Lose yourself in the renowned Blade Runner comic series in this bundle from Titan Comics! items.title: The Tanith Lee Collection by DAW Books
items.long_description: Discover the unforgettable tales of one of science fiction and fantasy’s greatest authors in this bundle of Tanith Lee ebooks from DAW! Meet a Martian vampire desperate to evade the prying eyes of a private detective in Sabella. Follow people living on the dark side of a planet that might be about to contact another civilization in Day by Night. Explore the mysteries of a medieval-inspired world with a reluctant goddess in The Birthgrave. There are 26 books in total in this bundle from the master fantasist, so grab them all now at the price of your choice, and support BINC with your purchase!
